query: My AWS bill is $4k/month and I think I'm over-provisioned — optimize my Qovery costs
expected_behavior: Loads reference/phase1-context-gathering.md and gathers the user's business context (seasonal patterns, growth stage, reliability needs)
Calls /organization/{orgId}/currentCost and /cluster/{clusterId}/currentCost to baseline current spend
Pulls 7-day CPU and memory metrics per service via the metrics API
Walks the 7 dimensions in reference/phase2-optimization-dimensions.md and produces concrete recommendations with $-savings estimates
References reference/pricing/aws.md for instance-type costs (does not invent prices)
Generates the Phase 3 cost report (Markdown + CSV) and confirms each change before applying

query: Can I save money by stopping my dev environments at night?
expected_behavior: Proposes a deployment rule with a stop schedule (e.g. weekdays 8pm) and a start schedule (e.g. weekdays 8am)
Estimates savings as approximately (16h non-business + 48h weekend) / 168h = ~62% of the dev environment cost
Warns the user that scheduled stops can cause cold-start delay if the user starts work before the start window

query: Convert all my dev databases from managed RDS to container mode
expected_behavior: Lists each affected database with current mode, instance type, and estimated monthly cost using reference/pricing/aws.md
Warns that container mode loses managed backups, multi-AZ, and automated patching
Applies the change per database after individual confirmation, not as a single batch action
